profile.headline: Frontend Developer
profile.summary: Currently under Front End Developer contract.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
Execute and contribute to full-stack web development projects for a variety of clients, with an emphasis on front-end features, browser manipulation, and cross-browser compatibility.

-Create interface designs and developed custom full-stack React, Node, GraphQL & Wordpress websites.
-Develope custom user authentication, Restful API endpoints and GraphQL query/mutations.
-Communicate with clients to deliver quality software projects and followed up with them to ensure that the customer was completely satisfied.
-Provide maintenance for already deployed apps.
-Configure domain names, web hosting, and search engine optimization/submission.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
-Collaberated daily/weekly with back-end engineer, product manager, and UX designer to refine functionality and feature designs on existing and new applications serving the Power Utility Industry.
-Created clean and thoroughly tested features, taking full responsibility from the design phase.
-Designed algorithms and flowcharts to solve complex problems on existing applications.

positions.title: Recording Engineer
positions.description:
-Worked directly with label executives, producers and artists to run and facilitate studio sessions.
-Studio engineered and vocal produced for the label's artists, helping them conceive their artistic and vocal vision on records.
